ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the central-distal portions of both lobes. Dense, speckled black mottling is concentrated along the proximal edges and central peduncle connection. Two distinct dark circular focal spots are visible on the interior white field of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 55 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge, transitioning into high-amplitude, irregular jagged clusters at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a concave sweep from the median notch, curving upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two high-contrast dark circular spots on the white region of the right lobe; a single small, high-intensity white circular spot centrally located near the notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible within the dark mottled region of the left lobe lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant textured encrustations (brownish-yellow pixel clusters) on the distal tips of both lobes; potential small parasitic scar near the center notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct brownish-yellow discoloration and heavy texture at the fluke tips, contrasting with the primary black and white fluke pigmentation.
